label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param.split(" ")[0] derived from request.getHeader("Referer"). The split operation preserves HTML/script characters within the first token of the Referer header, allowing attacker-controlled data to reach the response writer without HTML encoding. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: Sink expression: response.getWriter().print(bar.toCharArray()) writes unsanitized bar to response.
Data flow: param from header decoded and passed to doSomething, returned as bar, printed to writer.
